# USGS.gov
> The U.S. Geological Survey provides authoritative science, data, maps, and monitoring about Earth systems, natural hazards, water, ecosystems, energy, minerals, and climate change.

USGS is a science agency of the U.S. Department of the Interior. Its website brings together mission-area overviews, topical science portals, real-time hazards monitoring, national mapping programs, water and biological data systems, publications, and searchable data releases for researchers, decision-makers, and the public.

## Science Explorer
- [Science Explorer](https://www.usgs.gov/science/science-explorer): Browse USGS science topics, programs, data, news, and educational resources.
- [Biology](https://www.usgs.gov/science/science-explorer/biology): Explore biological science on species, habitats, ecosystems, and conservation.
- [Climate](https://www.usgs.gov/science/science-explorer/climate): Access climate science on impacts, adaptation, land use, and environmental change.
- [Coasts](https://www.usgs.gov/science/science-explorer/coasts): Find coastal science on hazards, shoreline change, ecosystems, and sea-level rise.
- [Maps and Mapping](https://www.usgs.gov/science/science-explorer/maps-and-mapping): Discover mapping, elevation, geospatial data, and cartographic resources.
- [Minerals](https://www.usgs.gov/science/science-explorer/minerals): Learn about mineral resources, critical minerals, and commodity information.
- [Natural Hazards](https://www.usgs.gov/science/science-explorer/natural-hazards): Explore earthquakes, volcanoes, landslides, floods, and related hazard science.
- [Ocean](https://www.usgs.gov/science/science-explorer/ocean): Access marine and ocean science on seafloor mapping and ecosystems.
- [Planetary Science](https://www.usgs.gov/science/science-explorer/planetary-science): Find planetary geology, astrogeology, and mapping of other worlds.

## Mission Areas
- [Mission Areas](https://www.usgs.gov/science/mission-areas): Overview of USGS mission areas and cross-cutting science priorities.
- [Core Science Systems](https://www.usgs.gov/mission-areas/core-science-systems): Geospatial infrastructure, mapping, data integration, and foundational science systems.
- [Ecosystems](https://www.usgs.gov/mission-areas/ecosystems): Science on species, habitats, invasive species, and ecosystem resilience.
- [Geology, Energy, and Minerals](https://www.usgs.gov/mission-areas/geology-energy-minerals): Research on geologic processes, energy resources, and mineral assessments.
- [Natural Hazards](https://www.usgs.gov/mission-areas/natural-hazards): Monitoring and research for earthquakes, volcanoes, landslides, and coastal hazards.
- [Water Resources](https://www.usgs.gov/mission-areas/water-resources): Water availability, quality, streamflow, groundwater, and hydrologic science.

## Hazards Monitoring
- [Earthquake Hazards Program](https://www.usgs.gov/programs/earthquake-hazards): Earthquake monitoring, hazard assessments, preparedness, and seismic data products.
- [Latest Earthquakes](https://earthquake.usgs.gov/earthquakes/map/): Interactive global earthquake map with recent events and feeds.
- [Volcano Hazards Program](https://www.usgs.gov/programs/VHP): Volcano monitoring, alerts, observatory updates, and eruption science.
- [Landslide Hazards Program](https://www.usgs.gov/programs/landslide-hazards): Landslide research, hazard assessments, and event information.
- [Coastal and Marine Hazards and Resources Program](https://www.usgs.gov/programs/cmhrp): Science on coastal change, storms, erosion, and marine geologic hazards.
- [WaterAlert](https://water.usgs.gov/wateralert/): Notifications for streamflow, groundwater, and water-quality conditions at monitoring sites.

## Water Data and Science
- [Water Resources Mission Area](https://www.usgs.gov/mission-areas/water-resources): Entry point for USGS hydrology, monitoring, and water science programs.
- [USGS Water Data for the Nation](https://waterdata.usgs.gov/nwis): National water data on streamflow, groundwater, and water quality.
- [Water Data for the Nation](https://www.usgs.gov/mission-areas/water-resources/science/water-data-nation): Overview of national water data access and services.
- [National Water Dashboard](https://dashboard.waterdata.usgs.gov/): Real-time map of stream, groundwater, precipitation, and water conditions.
- [WaterAlert](https://water.usgs.gov/wateralert/): Subscribe to custom alerts for changing hydrologic conditions.
- [Water Resources Research Act Program](https://www.usgs.gov/programs/water-resources-research-act-program): Information on state water institutes and research funding.

## Maps, Imagery, and Geospatial Data
- [The National Map](https://www.usgs.gov/the-national-map-data-delivery): Access topographic, hydrography, elevation, and transportation datasets.
- [US Topo Maps](https://www.usgs.gov/programs/national-geospatial-program/us-topo-maps-america): Download current USGS topographic maps for the United States.
- [3D Elevation Program (3DEP)](https://www.usgs.gov/3d-elevation-program): National elevation data and lidar program information.
- [Landsat Missions](https://www.usgs.gov/landsat-missions): Satellite imagery, products, and mission updates for Landsat.
- [EarthExplorer](https://earthexplorer.usgs.gov/): Search and download satellite imagery, aerial photos, and geospatial datasets.
- [ScienceBase](https://www.sciencebase.gov/): Collaborative platform for USGS data, metadata, and project information.
- [National Geospatial Program](https://www.usgs.gov/core-science-systems/ngp): National geospatial data stewardship and mapping program.

## Biology, Ecosystems, and Environmental Health
- [Ecosystems Mission Area](https://www.usgs.gov/mission-areas/ecosystems): Ecosystem science supporting conservation, restoration, and resource management.
- [Biological Threats and Invasive Species Research Program](https://www.usgs.gov/programs/biological-threats-and-invasive-species-research-program): Research on invasive species, wildlife disease, and ecological threats.
- [Environmental Health Program](https://www.usgs.gov/programs/environmental-health-program): Science on contaminants, pathogens, and ecosystem and human health.
- [Gap Analysis Project](https://www.usgs.gov/programs/gap-analysis-project): Data and analysis on biodiversity, land cover, and protected areas.
- [National Wildlife Health Center](https://www.usgs.gov/centers/nwhc): Wildlife disease diagnostics, surveillance, and health science resources.
- [Wetland and Aquatic Research Center](https://www.usgs.gov/centers/wetland-and-aquatic-research-center): Research on wetlands, aquatic ecosystems, and restoration.

## Climate, Land Change, and Coasts
- [Climate Science](https://www.usgs.gov/science/science-explorer/climate): Climate impacts, adaptation science, and environmental change resources.
- [Land Change Science Program](https://www.usgs.gov/programs/land-change-science-program): Research on land use, land cover, and Earth surface change.
- [Climate Adaptation Science Centers](https://www.usgs.gov/programs/climate-adaptation-science-centers): Regional science partnerships supporting climate adaptation decisions.
- [Coasts](https://www.usgs.gov/science/science-explorer/coasts): Coastal hazards, ecosystems, sediment transport, and shoreline change.
- [Coastal Change Hazards Portal](https://marine.usgs.gov/coastalchangehazardsportal/ui/): Interactive maps and forecasts for coastal storm impacts and shoreline change.
- [LandCarbon](https://www.usgs.gov/programs/land-change-science-program/science/landcarbon): Carbon dynamics science related to land use and ecosystem change.

## Energy, Minerals, and Geology
- [Geology, Energy, and Minerals Mission Area](https://www.usgs.gov/mission-areas/geology-energy-minerals): Mission-area overview for geologic mapping, resources, and Earth processes.
- [Mineral Resources Program](https://www.usgs.gov/programs/mineral-resources-program): Mineral assessments, critical minerals science, and commodity information.
- [National Mineral Information Center](https://www.usgs.gov/centers/national-minerals-information-center): Statistics and analysis on mineral commodities and supply chains.
- [Energy Resources Program](https://www.usgs.gov/programs/energy-resources-program): Assessments of oil, gas, coal, and geothermal resources.
- [Geologic Maps](https://ngmdb.usgs.gov/ngmdb/ngmdb_home.html): National Geologic Map Database for geologic maps and reports.
- [Astrogeology Science Center](https://www.usgs.gov/centers/astrogeology-science-center): Planetary mapping, geologic interpretation, and solar system data products.

## Publications and Data
- [Publications Warehouse](https://pubs.usgs.gov/): Search USGS reports, maps, books, and series publications.
- [USGS Data Releases](https://www.usgs.gov/products/data/data-releases): Find published USGS datasets with citations and metadata.
- [ScienceBase](https://www.sciencebase.gov/): Access data catalogs, metadata records, and project repositories.
- [USGS Store](https://store.usgs.gov/): Download maps, publications, and public-domain USGS products.
- [USGS Library](https://www.usgs.gov/products/libraries/usgs-library): Library services, catalogs, and research collections.
- [DOI for USGS Data](https://www.usgs.gov/products/data/dois-usgs-data-releases): Guidance and access for digital object identifiers on data releases.

## News, Education, and Search
- [News](https://www.usgs.gov/news): Agency news, featured stories, and science updates.
- [Multimedia Gallery](https://www.usgs.gov/media/images): Images and visual media from USGS science activities.
- [Education](https://www.usgs.gov/education): Educational resources, lessons, and learning materials.
- [Search](https://www.usgs.gov/search): Search across USGS science pages, publications, and data resources.
- [Energy Search](https://www.usgs.gov/search?keywords=energy): Search results focused on USGS energy science content.
- [Environmental Health Search](https://www.usgs.gov/search?keywords=environmental%20health): Search results for environmental health science and programs.
- [Geology Search](https://www.usgs.gov/search?keywords=geology): Search results for geology topics, programs, and publications.
- [Water Search](https://www.usgs.gov/search?keywords=water): Search results for water science, data, and monitoring resources.
